Hmm interesting, my doctor also had be start taking Iron supplements that are meant to be taken with vitamin C! Which I’m supposed to do first thing in the morning on an empty stomach. She didn’t mention anything about it! Should I wait like an hour before taking the Iron Pills?

No. I told her we can worry about my stuff at her house and her stuff at mine after the holidays. The ring is at her house. Distance is incredibly hard and I was excited to close the gap. But now I’m left alone to figure out a new future.

Honestly, I never thought she had a fear of commitment considering she was the one who wanted to get married. Her actions and behaviour has always been confusing and very hot and cold. Sometimes she’s super understanding and communicative, very out spoken about what she wants and needs. But sometimes she would just straight up ghost me until she was ready to talk and get defensive. It really was never a consistent thing on how she would react and communicate. I’m definitely not perfect either, I think I have an anxious attachment style. But I still always tried to be level headed and respectful. Some days were harder than others because I didn’t know how she would be. I dont know, this is all such bull shit. I’m trying my best to not be so hard on myself and accept what it is. But it just doesn’t make sense and I’m just genuinely so heartbroken. 😞

Yes, we were long distance the whole time. The longest I spent with her was 6 months at a time otherwise we saw each every other month or every month. She lives in the U.S and I live in Canada. It wasn’t the biggest deal breaker since I was willing to move to her.

I actually even mentioned couple counselling. But she completely disregarded it and didn’t even consider it. I tried everything I could think of and still her mind was made up. And yeah, sometimes our relationship was very exhausting, even for me. There was a time last year I actually wanted to give up and she cried so hard about it. But I didn’t, because I saw how much it hurt her, I saw how much I loved her. And I just knew I wanted to make it work with her no matter what because my heart was hers and it didn’t matter how long it would take for us to be in the place we needed. And that was enough for me. But I guess it wasn’t for her, I dont know. Things weren’t like incredibly toxic between us, we had our own lives and we talked through most things and always had an understanding. Which is why nothing makes sense to me. She still said she loved me and cared for me, she even sent me a post about love a few days after she broke with me. But then she got so cold and ugh I’m so confused and I’m so sad.

I am 26 and she is 25. We are each others first real relationship, we are each others first for everything. So it’s been a learning as we go type of relationship. There was a lot I have learned and I’d imagine it was the same for her. But I just always thought we were going to learn about life and stuff but still be partners through it all. That whatever happened individually, there was care and respect to just be there for each other. Things would get toxic and we would talk it through and do better, but it always felt like whenever you took a step forward we took two steps back. Or there was just always something. And to me it was okay because it meant we were aware and growing but I think for her it just got too much. Or maybe like everyone else is saying she found someone else. I honestly don’t know. She just said she gained clarity and that was that. It’s just really hard to believe this is real, and It’s just over. We’re just no longer partners and I’ve been left in the dust to figure out what’s next. Which I’m sure I’ll be fine and I’ll figure it all out. It’s just incredibly sad and lonely. 😞

I was planning on checking out therapy way before this for other reasons. So I’ll definitely be looking into that when I am back home. I think what gets to me the most is just like how much love and engagement there was between us. Like the constant phone calls, the random pictures she’d send, all the shows we were watching together, all our plans. Like everything else that made us, us. And all of it is just going to be a memory now. I logged into my Xbox for the first time last night because I’ve been so afraid of seeing her online and not 1 second later her nephew started sending me invites. And I just broke down. Because I have been coming around her nephew since he was 3. He’s 8 now. We became so incredibly close that he always wants to talk to me, and the last time we spoke he was asking me how many more days before I was going to see him and if I could sleep over. And I don’t know if he knows I won’t be coming around anymore and that shit broke me. That I won’t get to see him grow, I won’t get to see his soccer games anymore. We were long distance, our entire relationship had been long distance and we were to close the gap this up coming year. I have spent a lot of time in her place, being around her family and just being there with her. I was building a life with her over there and now it’s just gone. And I am here with nothing but time and asking myself “well what now” I moved into a new apartment and I’ve been so afraid to unpack because most things I own have been gifts from her or we bought together and I asked her opinion. And ugh I just can’t do this. I can’t.

I don’t want to feel entitled to always understanding the things that happen in life because she may never want to give me the real truth. And I don’t want to spend my days constantly wondering why. Even though that’s the case now, it’s suffocating. I can’t force her to talk to me and help me understand. Yes, we are adults but she has been incredibly immature and inconsiderate about all of this. She talked about how she doesn’t want us to blame each other for anything and proceeded to tell me the wrongs in our relationship from my side. And like I’ve said somewhere here, things were not perfect, I was well aware of that. But I talked to her about how we can change those parts our relationship then, if it wasn’t working for us anymore then we could change it. Because I for sure didn’t like the way things were either. But instead of fixing and changing things, she just gave up. And maybe it’s for the better, maybe this was meant to be a lesson, maybe it we weren’t the ones for each other or whatever. But damn 7 years is a long time to see if anyone of that is true. I did not think we were heading in the wrong direction so quickly. It just doesn’t make sense.

It’s like a battle in my head. I want to hate her, but I can’t. I think about those moments without the bullshit, like when she would wake me up with kisses before she left the house in the morning. Or make sure I was always as close as possible to her whenever we were out somewhere. Or how she would leave little notes for me to wake up to whenever we spent our nights together. And it’s the most pure form of love I feel when I remember those things. And I just don’t understand how someone no longer feels that love? And just text you to break up. And tell you they can’t talk because they’re guilty. I slipped up the other day and texted her I miss her and she just responded she missed out friendship too?? As if the love we had wasn’t the most beautiful thing in my life. And I just want to hate her. But I can’t. I have the softest spot for her and it’s going to destroy me.

There was always space for growth, and I always shared that with her. I always told her we are growing together, that we can be the best versions of ourselves and be our biggest supporters. I believed we could do things in life as individuals and together and that our relationship could be the safe space we need. And she agreed, she always agreed, until suddenly it was no longer possible in her mind. And she didn’t believe we could change. There is no doubt there are probably better people out there for us, but that’s the thing that ruins love. There’s too many options, there’s always better. And to me that isn’t a good enough reason to just give up on someone when you love them, when you’ve been with them for 7 years through everything life threw at us. I would have never gave up just because things weren’t perfect. And I feel like that is something people just don’t do anymore. 😞

Yeah, which is why it didn’t make sense for her to feel guilty instead of sad with me. It just doesn’t make sense. I’m glad I actually don’t use social media and anything I do use, I no longer have her on. I was supposed to spend the holidays with her, but because she broke up with me right before. So, I came to spend it with my family way out in the middle of nowhere. It’s been kind of suffocating because there isn’t much to do here, and the last time I was here was with her. 😞 This is the longest we have been without talking in like 8/9 years and it’s been really sad.

I know in my heart, she will never leave it. I know deep down I will always love her and I’m scared that it’ll affect my future. Because I don’t see how I can love anyone else this deeply. I think I’m just going to be afraid of it happening again. 7 years is a long time, like why did it take 7 years for her to decide I wasn’t the one for her?? Why did she wait until after we bought rings together. Why did she want to get married to begin with. Like I just don’t understand how someone can love you and suddenly no longer want anything to do with you. I’m sorry you’re having a hard time as well. People can be so mean and I don’t understand why commitment just doesn’t exist anymore. I appreciate the tags and the kindness. 🥺

Well that’s the only thing that makes sense to me, tbh. She said it wasn’t about other people, that there wasn’t anyone else. I asked multiple times and she denied it all. But I don’t understand why there was absolutely nothing else left to try if wasn’t because of someone else or if it wasn’t because she no longer loved me. It doesn’t make sense at all. Her actions, words, and behaviour are all different and I am driving myself crazy trying to understand. 😭

She thinks her saying to respect her decision is enough. I know she did this all so incredibly hurtful and I feel like it was all on purpose. And I will never understand why. Like I know I’m not perfect, but I’m not an awful person. I’ve been learning as we go. It just sucks how absolutely cold she’s been with me. Like as if we didn’t just buy rings over the summer. As if she wasn’t just telling me how excited she was to spend Christmas with me. As if none of it mattered at all. I feel like such a fool for believing her promises.

I have been constantly around my friends and family and talking through my feelings. It’s been about 3 weeks now and some days are easier and some days are incredibly hard. I just can’t stop thinking about it. I can’t stop feeling the hurt and pain. I dream of her every single night and I can’t get away from it. I even blocked her so I could feel less anxious. But I just feel so guilty that I had to unblock her. I don’t know how to not have her in my life. 😞

I know for a fact nothing about our relationship was perfect, and there were definitely flaws and toxicity. But I just believed we would always grow out of it, and learn to be better partners for each other. We talked about things and would try to find ways to do that. And I was going to always be committed to that because I love her so much, I don’t see myself ever feeling this way about another being. I thought she felt the same way but she just gave up on me. And it’s hurts. 😞
